load_pretrained_checkpoint: load a pretrained model checkpoint from a file path into a PyTorch model using load_state_dict
setup_distributed_training: initialize a distributed training process group with NCCL backend for multi-GPU or SLURM cluster environments
create_smoothed_value: create a SmoothedValue tracker to compute rolling median, average, and global statistics over a window of values
create_metric_logger: create a MetricLogger to track multiple training metrics and log them at configurable intervals during iteration
log_training_metrics: log training metrics like loss and accuracy every N iterations with ETA and memory usage using MetricLogger
